label: Remnant general
note: The Remnant general in the barracks yard (src/systems/npc/general_post.gd): a garrison member like any trooper, so he can be shot, and on the town alarm he fights where he stands (hold_ground, from cruiser_general.json). Named by his card (General Vask), never comes back once dead (WorldState.on_general_killed). His look is general.json's 'outfit'. Only the blocks below differ from cruiser_general.json.
